alin: quick report: CI fuzz found instability when FP8 runs on microburst traffic (single-request bursts). loss spikes and occasional token collapse. anyone seen?
marc: saw one of those in shadow. seems tied to per-head scale outliers when sequence length varies widely inside the batch.
tess: microbursts are tough because per-request stats dominate. We could add a "microburst_safe" precision path that uses per-layer median-scales and forces INT8 on layers with high kurtosis.
alin: median-scales sounds cheap. prefer algorithmic fallback over full-precision fallback to keep cost down. how do we detect high kurtosis cheaply?
marc: approximate by clipping top/bottom 2% of channel scales and computing trimmed std/mean. cheap and robust. threshold: trimmed_cv > 0.3 -> degrade.
tess: also suggest a per-model config flag `microburst_mode: "conservative"|"auto"` so regulated customers can pin safety. default: auto.
ci-bot: note: test-suite:quant_microburst added, will run on PR.
alin: rollout plan: 1) add trimmed-CV check + median-scale path, 2) add microburst_mode config, 3) add smoke test in CI and a small shadow canary for 48h.
marc: telemetry: tag `quant.microburst.trigger` + per-request `precision_level` for cost accounting.
tess: edge: KV cache warmup interacts; if we use median-scale we must annotate cache entries with scale version to avoid mixing.
alin: action items: alin -> proto trimmed-cv impl; marc -> telemetry + canary; tess -> config + docs; open PR by EOD.
